name: Mistral La Plateforme
desc: Mistral's hosted API and console for models, fine-tuning and agents
desc_zh: Mistral 的托管 API 与控制台，提供模型、微调与智能体能力
solves: Connecting a model means finding endpoints, writing auth, absorbing each vendor's differences, and handling fine-tuning and rollout. One console plus API covers it.
solves_zh: 接模型要自己找端点、写鉴权、适配各家差异，还要管微调和上线。一套控制台加 API 就够了。
best_for: You want to call models from code and also handle fine-tuning and usage tracking.
best_for_zh: 你要在代码里调用模型，并顺便做微调和用量管理。
notes: 官网跳转登录（302 循环），未取到公开页面
